examples.text: Aber auch das Schnurren und Strählen, das Aufsagen von Narrensprüchle steht in der alten Fasnachtstradition. Eine Tradition, die nicht mehr von vielen Zünften und Gruppen gelebt wird.
examples.translation: But also the mocking and heckling, the reciting of fools' sayings stands in the old Carnival tradition. A tradition, that is no longer kept alive by many guilds and groups.
examples.english: But also the mocking and heckling, the reciting of fools' sayings stands in the old Carnival tradition. A tradition, that is no longer kept alive by many guilds and groups.
